subject: gk
question: Who among the following is NOT a part of the committee, which is constructed to provide suggestions to the Prime Minister regarding the appointment of a chief commissioner of Central Information Commission?

options.text: A Union Cabinet Minister appointed by Prime Minister
Leader of Opposition in Lok Sabha

solution:
The correct answer is __**Speaker of Lok Sabha**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Chief commissioner of Central Information Commission is appointed by the President on the recommendation of a committee consisting of
 
 
• the Prime Minister as Chairperson,
 
• the Leader of Opposition in the Lok Sabha and
 
• a Union Cabinet Minister nominated by the Prime Minister.
 
 
 
• Hence Speaker of Lok of Sabha is correct answer.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• ​Central Information Commission was established by the **Central Government in 2005.**
 
• Chief Information Commissioner is not a constitutional body, so there is no provision of it in the Indian Construction.
 
• Post of Central Information Commission is derived from the provision of **Section-12 RTI Act, 2005.**
 
• **​Yashwardhan Kumar Sinhahad **been appointed as the 11th ​Central Information Commission CIC of India.
 
• ​The Central Information Commission falls under **Ministry of Personnel.**
